hypothesis: A durable archive-member receipt plus Makefile dependency audit proves whether the q1 package builds LibNC from source or merely links the bundled binary.
interfaces_exposed: Q2 census -> durable tar-member hashes and Makefile dependency proof -> corrected eligibility receipt
kill_condition: If Makefile links bundled libnc.so and supplies no build rule or complete source, preserve NNCP only as teacher evidence.
promotion_condition: Pass only if complete buildable OSI LibNC source or a receipt-bound written committee exception exists.
retired_neighborhoods: Do not treat a temporary extraction path or redistributable binary as source provenance.
title: NNCP LibNC durable source-eligibility audit
